printers_connection_fields.name: printers_connection_fields
printers_connection_fields.value: ("printers"."connection" = 'network' AND "printers"."host" IS NOT NULL) OR ("printers"."connection" = 'os_printer' AND "printers"."os_printer_name" IS NOT NULL)

sales_committed_has_receipt.name: sales_committed_has_receipt
sales_committed_has_receipt.value: "sales"."status" <> 'committed' OR ("sales"."receipt_no" IS NOT NULL AND "sales"."committed_at" IS NOT NULL)
